row: Elite Performance Chiropractic, based in San Diego and led by Dr. Travis Ehlers, is committed to helping patients reach their highest level of health and performance. While the clinic has a strong focus on treating sports-related injuries, it also offers expert care for children, personal injury cases, auto accidents and workplace injuries. Their approach emphasizes whole-body wellness, combining personalized treatment plans with advanced techniques such as soft tissue therapy, cupping, and shockwave therapy. Whether you’re recovering from an injury or looking to optimize your physical well-being, their team provides attentive, results-driven chiropractic care tailored to your needs.
